business_problem: give scientists near-real-time access to experiment data instead of waiting on instrument-bound workflows and manual bottlenecks.
solution_summary: Ginkgo Bioworks uses Snowflake and Streamlit on Snowflake to give scientists near-real-time access to experiment data instead of waiting on instrument-bound workflows and manual bottlenecks. Experiment, sample, and laboratory data are centralized in Snowflake so scientists and data teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Streamlit helps expose curated outputs through self-service applications and dashboards so non-technical users can act on the data quickly. The platform also connects with Tableau so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Ginkgo gives scientists faster access to experiment data, reduces instrument bottlenecks, and extends trusted BI access to more than 1,000 team members across the organization.
